verdict.rationale: The official README confirms that Codex can be used with an API key instead of signing in with ChatGPT, but notes it "requires additional setup" and recommends ChatGPT account sign-in as the primary path. The pack gives no details on how to configure API-key auth. Missing for 10: documented API-key setup steps (env var or login flag), clarity on which surfaces (CLI/IDE/cloud) accept API keys, usage/billing differences versus plan login, independent hands-on corroboration.
